description: List the key of every FRC event a team has competed at across all years. Lightest variant of get_team_events_all; useful for driving per-event queries over a team's whole history.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

name: get_team_events_all_keys
title: Get All Team Event Keys (History)
